title: Alfred↔HAL Task Handoff Contract
description: Formal specification for every task delegated from Alfred to HAL. Prevents ambiguity, rework, and feature creep.

objective.description: One-line goal + critical constraints. Must be specific enough that HAL can't misinterpret. Examples: 'Fix HAL dispatch latency without breaking message ordering', 'Implement preflight handshake (3s timeout max, no blocking calls)'

constraints.description: Hard boundaries for the task. Include: scope limits, budget/time, safety rules, compatibility requirements, forbidden actions.

code.description: Exact files/artifacts to create or modify (relative paths or ~/workspace). Examples: ['gateway/preflight.js', 'scripts/route-task.sh', '~/routing-policy.json']

tests.description: Test commands + expected output. Each entry is 'bash/npm command (expected result)'. Examples: ['npm test -- gateway/preflight.test.js (expect: all passing)', 'bash scripts/test-routing.sh (expect: zero errors)']

docs.description: Documentation files to create. Examples: ['IMPLEMENTATION.md (setup + usage)', 'API.md (endpoint schema)', 'ROLLBACK.md (revert steps)']

validation_command.description: Single shell command to prove task is done. Should be runnable in one invocation and exit 0 on success. Example: 'npm test && bash scripts/validate.sh'

success_criteria.description: Measurable acceptance criteria. These are checked manually by Alfred during review. Examples: ['Preflight latency <3s for all probes', '100% of tasks routed per policy', 'No regressions in existing tests']

owner.description: Who is responsible for final sign-off. Usually 'alfred' (Alfred reviews before production). Use 'joe' only for approval-gate tasks.

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). When task must be complete + reviewed.

hours.description: Estimated wall-clock hours (includes coding + testing + docs)

model_tier.description: Recommended model tier for this task

parent_task_id.description: If this task is part of a larger phase, link the parent card (e.g., 'card_001')

related_cards.description: Other cards this depends on or affects

memory_refs.description: Links to MEMORY.md sections for context (e.g., 'MEMORY.md#Phase-1-Preflight')

acceptance_note.description: Personal note from Alfred to HAL on what matters most in this task
